name: Zykalian Militia
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged Infantry (special) · 175 leadership · T3 Seasonal (S: Legacy of Fire)

origin.text: Seasonal Unit (Season V: Legacy of Fire)

order: top Amya guide alt allocation: 6 points Top / 9 points Bottom; last 2 points personal preference (+2 Top = 288 fire damage; +2 Bottom = +40% ammo).

pitch: A grenade-throwing exotic that shreds blobs from range but has zero flank or duelling presence — cycle V and ability 2 and keep moving, or die to any diver that reaches it. The 2026-06 nerf (cooldowns 10s→16s, reload +33%, poison cap 20→8) stretches that rotation out, so pre-patch pacing guidance no longer holds at face value.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.
doctrines.note: 3/6/9 hits, alternative to Scorching or Siege

battleRole.positioning: Deploy on a protected flank behind blob formations {1}. Maintain constant X-movement after each V or ability-2 cast — never stand still {1}. Reposition to keep DPS pressure up {1}.
battleRole.tips: Press V to damage front-line blob (less ammo, more spread than spell 1). Press ability-2 to hit back line and apply debuff; hard-priority target if enemy has flamers or rival Zykalian units {1}. ALWAYS cycle V and ability-2 {1}; solitary spell-2 play loses 50% potential damage. Post-patch, that rotation now runs on a tighter timing budget {3, 4}. Avoid spell 1 to preserve ammo economy {1}.

matchups.pressure: You pressure: blob frontlines and ranged backlines via V and ability-2 rotation, applying fire DPS and poison debuff {1}.

controls.notes: Core loop is **V (grenade) → ability-2 (debuff + back-line pressure) → X-move instantly**. Post-patch, ability cooldowns stretch from 10s to 16s {3, 4}, requiring tighter sequencing. Spell 1 is a trap in normal play (ammo sink); reserve it only for overstacked poison refresh if needed. Hero pairing: any {1}. Leadership priority (purple-tier-lock meta): Zykalian ranks top-tier alongside Imperial Pike Guards, Stalwarts, Paladins for doctrine investment {5}.

gaps: No formation guidance (house card has no formation notes; Amya guide references only F1/F2 implicit in positioning, not explicit).
Post-patch playbook: sources predate the 2026-06-25 nerf (cooldowns +60%, reload +33%, poison cap −60%); rotation viability and positioning urgency may shift. Doc priority flagged High.
Mobility Doctrine V Sprint duration disagreement: Amya records 12s, the house card records 8s. No patch note documents a change between them, so treat this as unresolved.
No hero-specific pairing notes for Zykalian itself: Amya states 'Any' hero pairs with it; the Shortsword hero-threat entry comes from that hero's own guide, not a Zykalian-side counter.
No counterplay notes from hostile matchup perspective (how to play against Zykalian) beyond the Shortsword cross-mention.
House caption nicknames ('cocos', 'ball boys') recur across multiple sources but their origin/meaning is never explained in-channel — included verbatim, not interpreted.

patch.summary: Throwing-skill cooldowns 10s→16s (both skills); reload time +33%; poison stack count 20→8
